criteria_required: genre-to-artists-to-overlapping-genres navigation on actual export
complete searchable lists, exact identities, missing-data abstentions
gates.explanation: Dated October 3 v4 actual Chromium evidence verifies required artist navigation, complete tested source-genre cohort, retained-identity pagination, outside-featured identities, prefix search, selected Unicode identities, history/reload, listening list, keyboard skip link and mobile layout on the hash-bound full retained-input export. The native replay accounts for all 2,999,670 identity rows, including 2,989,361 without observed genres. These engineering tasks supersede the older 150-artist testimony for this dated export; complete original discovery acceptance remains unreviewed and v5 integration is pending.

criteria_required: fresh offline reconstruction of declared full-corpus inputs and outputs
input hashes, code revision, parameters, seeds, output hashes and replay verification
gates.explanation: The unavailable sealed legacy artifacts remain unavailable, but they no longer block the separately named retained-input reconstruction route. Actual dated v4 native-row/source/export replay validates all 2,999,670 identity rows and binds the exact receipt/output inventory, source hashes and validator hashes; measured replay used 298788 KiB maximum RSS in 149.323 seconds. The receipt records construction/recovery rather than an independently compared fresh rebuild, and its construction and replay validator snapshots differ. Independent fresh output comparison and final v5 evidence remain absent; the complete original gate remains unmet.

criteria_required: source-level licenses and permitted projections verified against raw receipts
optional NC/SA packs excluded from unrestricted core and correctly labeled derivatives
dated Every Noise observations used only for separate evaluation
gates.explanation: The dated v4 receipt binds distinct CC0 identity/claim, FMA metadata/features and eight permitted per-track audio inputs. Native Wikidata report retains structured-data CC0 proof and native FMA report retains exact URL assertions, audio licenses and bounded ZIP ranges without claiming a full archive hash. This improves source custody but is not a reviewed complete license/training-boundary acceptance. Optional NC/SA derivatives and historical evaluation boundaries still require the original explicit review; blended ListenBrainz/MLHD permission remains unresolved and v5 is pending.

criteria_required: reviewed broad, subgenre and microgenre labels across regions, languages and eras
full artist denominator, exact bridges, sparse/cold artists and unsupported labels retained
gates.explanation: Dated native entity evidence verifies 9992 of 10000 capped candidates, retaining eight non-unique exact-ID outcomes and 18750 native P136 statements across 1003 labels. Dated v4 reconstruction retains 2,999,670 identities, 1018 genres, 10309 genre-labeled artists and 10553 detail profiles; FMA retains a separate 16916-artist/109727-track/164-label namespace with 168 exact artist bridges and zero recording bridges. Literal country/language/date assertions are not musical-region/language/era classifications. Reviewed broad/sub/micro communities and global representativeness remain absent; this is declared-source coverage, not global musical coverage.

criteria_required: independent blinded judgments of memberships and neighbors beyond source reconstruction
prespecified stratified protocol, disagreements, uncertainty and unsuccessful cases
gates.explanation: No independent blinded membership and neighbor relevance judgments are supplied.

criteria_required: frozen disjoint folds with no target leakage and independent replay
baselines, cold artists, unseen labels and source-conditional denominators
gates.explanation: Prior FMA independent audit and selected recovery evidence remain retained. New source-membership report freezes a component calibration/confirmation partition and acknowledges previously observed test diagnostics, source-positive unknown negatives and absence of unseen-positive test cases. Its final independent native/model replay and the new open-model replay are pending; report prose and saved-rank testimony do not establish complete frozen-fold and baseline acceptance for the intended foundation.

criteria_required: multiple broad/sub/micro memberships separated from direct observations
held-out calibration, abstention and stability across evidence-volume strata
gates.explanation: Dated FMA source-membership report supplies component calibration thresholds, bounded overlapping sets, abstention and rank sensitivity for 11/164 native labels; 152 lack minimum positive component support and one has an unsupported missing-score tail. This is source-positive calibration, not calibrated musical confidence or reviewed broad/sub/micro memberships. Final independent native/model replay, broader evidence-volume stability and independent listener labels remain absent.

criteria_required: diverse exact-credit sonic metadata with missingness, age and sample accounting
independent sonic retrieval evaluation and separately evaluated cultural/sonic blend
gates.explanation: Exact native sonic custody retains 55 recordings in its selected identity scope. Dated v4 integrates complete separate FMA accounting of 16916 artists, 109727 tracks and 164 labels, with 168 exact artist bridges and zero exact recording bridges; acoustic missingness cannot be removed by name joins. Native source/model audit is source conditional. Final PCA/model replay and independent sonic retrieval plus cultural/sonic blend judgments remain pending.

criteria_required: stable independently assessed semantic neighborhoods and interpretable axes
readable display layout separated from semantics, complete unpositioned alternatives
gates.explanation: Prior taxonomy source-edge and local-layout evidence is retained; dated v4 accounts for the complete retained identity lists and source cohorts. The new FMA PCA map final independent replay is pending. No independently assessed musical neighborhoods, stable semantic axes or complete semantic map acceptance is supplied by source-edge recovery or display layout.

criteria_required: exact recording credits distinct from release credits with sufficient discography coverage
independent musical fit and diversity review of defining examples
gates.explanation: Selected exact native recording credits remain separate from release credits. Dated native FMA evidence resolves 168 exact artist bridges and zero exact recording bridges across 109727 eligible tracks; eight licensed excerpts are listening engineering evidence, not defining-example selection. Sufficient selected-discography coverage and independent introduction-fit/diversity review remain absent.

criteria_required: permitted listening links with provider availability and missingness accounting
independently assessed central, recent and emerging recording selections
gates.explanation: Dated native evidence preserves 36 exact recording-source outcomes and nine external destinations without provider playback availability claims. Actual dated v4 Chromium evidence now verifies decode/play/pause and approximately 30-second durations for all eight permitted FMA clips, attribution, no autoplay/initial audio fetch, same-origin requests, keyboard and mobile tasks. Local lists and excerpt playback do not establish regional external-provider access or independently reviewed central/recent/emerging selections; these original criteria remain unmet.

criteria_required: actual-export search, selection, full lists, history, deep links and reload
keyboard and mobile tasks, source/inference distinctions, minimal readable interface
gates.explanation: Dated October 3 v4 actual-export Chromium receipt now supplies byte-bound search, artist selection, tested complete source-genre cohort, identity pagination, deep-link/history/reload, keyboard skip-link and mobile no-overflow tasks. It labels unverified provider links and confirms no external audio requests. Separate eight-clip browser evidence checks attribution, keyboard/mobile listening and no autoplay. This supersedes the older selected-cohort-only description for the dated v4 export, but complete original product/source-inference/usability review and final v5 certification remain unaccepted.
